| Service | File |

Note that the directory also contains `proto/api/v1/common.proto` and `proto/api/v1/README.md`, but neither declares a service — `common.proto` only holds shared message/enum definitions. Each service name maps to the file it is declared in, so the count of service declarations equals the count of `*_service.proto` files.
